item.title: Aircraft Detection in Sentinel-2 Satellite Images
Automatic Ship Detection in the Great Belt Bridge Area
item.description:
Project Overview

Working with computer vision in maritime environments is not a simple task. What started as a straightforward idea for data extraction ultimately evolved into a research publication and became the foundation for my master’s thesis on autonomous systems and multi-sensor data fusion. This project ignited my deep involvement in open-source intelligence (OSINT) and coastal surveillance - areas where I am driven to create a real impact.

item.title: Military Aircraft Classification
item.description:
Project Overview

This was one of my first major projects, serving as a crucial stepping stone during my application to DTU. It ignited my deep involvement in machine learning, particularly in defence and military applications - an area where I have always been driven to create a real impact.

Data and Challenges

To build this solution, I utilised the open-source “Military Aircraft Detection Dataset”. Knowing that real-world problems require robust data, I expanded this dataset with my own photographs taken at various airshows across Poland and Europe over the last 15 years (full album available here). A portion of these photos ultimately served as my test data.
